hero.subtitle: SaSilva Tech is a boutique consultancy specialised in cybersecurity, regulatory compliance – NIS2, the EU AI Act and GDPR – and intelligent IoT systems, dedicated to helping hospitals, industry, large consultancies and law firms resolve complex technical challenges. Built on decades of frontier scientific research and real-world engineering experience in critical environments, SaSilva Tech combines academic rigour with technical depth to deliver opinions, audits and architectures that withstand the closest scrutiny.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Specialized technical consulting for the most demanding challenges.
services.card_1_title: NIS2 Technical Compliance Audits for IoT/OT Infrastructure
services.card_1_desc: On-the-ground, not only documentary, assessment of the cybersecurity posture of connected devices and industrial control systems, for hospitals, industry and logistics, under the NIS2 Directive and its national transposition.
services.card_2_title: Human Oversight Assessment for AI Systems (AI Act)
services.card_2_desc: Independent technical verification that high-risk AI systems genuinely meet, in practice, not only on paper, the human oversight requirements of Article 14 of the EU AI Act.
services.card_3_title: Specialised Technical Advisory for the Legal Sector
services.card_3_desc: Independent scientific and technical consultancy for law firms: authoritative technical opinions, expert audits for litigation and arbitration, and technical validation of intellectual property or compliance with AI and data protection regulations.
services.card_4_title: Intelligent Systems, IoT and Edge AI
services.card_4_desc: Design, development and optimisation of IoT solutions for industrial environments and smart cities, integrating decentralised Artificial Intelligence (Edge AI / Federated Learning) for maximum privacy and resource efficiency.
services.note: We work both directly with organisations and as a technical partner to larger international consultancies, whenever an additional layer of technical depth is needed within their own compliance engagements.

advantages.title: The Advantages
advantages.subtitle: The advantages of specialized technical consulting.
advantages.card_1_desc: Decision-making based on rigorous, validated scientific methodologies prevents obsolete investments and critical architectural failures.
advantages.card_2_desc: The integration of advanced solutions ensures compliance with the strictest data protection standards when developing complex systems.
advantages.card_3_desc: Direct access to cutting-edge engineering insight enables organizations to anticipate trends and secure a leading technological position.

about.title: The Value of Our Technical Team
about.text_1: The core value of SaSilva Tech lies in the solid background and international reputation of its founding team. With an academic career grounded in advanced research in networks, the Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence, the founder bridges deep theoretical knowledge with hands-on engineering experience on real-world projects, supported by collaborators dedicated to specific areas such as management, digital production and technical expertise. This synergy ensures that every opinion, audit or proposed architecture benefits from the highest level of market rigour and scientific validation.

track.title: Illustrative Track Record
track.intro: The cases below represent the research and engineering background behind SaSilva Tech – not engagements delivered by the company itself, which was only recently established.
track.case_1_desc: An IoT platform for remote monitoring of heavy machinery across multiple brands, including machines with no native onboard systems, field-validated with one of Portugal's largest construction companies. Result: predictive fault detection and an international (PCT) patent filing.
track.case_2_desc: A research concept for “Guardian Agent” AI systems that supervise autonomous systems on critical infrastructure – energy, transport, healthcare – with native compliance with the AI Act and the NIS2 Directive. Includes the design of a validation pilot in nephrology, in partnership with a hospital in Spain.
track.case_3_desc: Validation, in a defence operational environment, of technology that measures cognitive and emotional load in real time to dynamically adjust security posture. The same technology applies to Security Operations Centres (SOCs) and industrial control rooms, where human fatigue is a direct safety risk.
